name: AWS — Cross-Source AssumeRole or Cross-Account Token Issuance
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("AssumeRole","AssumeRoleWithSAML","AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity")
| filter xdm.event.outcome = "SUCCESS"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "AdministratorAccess"
       or xdm.event.description contains "PowerUserAccess"
       or xdm.event.description contains "OrganizationAccountAccess"
       or xdm.event.description contains "BreakGlass"
| filter not (xdm.event.description contains "AWSServiceRoleFor"
       or xdm.event.description contains "InstanceProfile"
       or xdm.event.description contains "/aws-service-role/")
| filter xdm.source.user.username != null and xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| comp min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, count() as assumes
  by xdm.source.user.username, xdm.source.ipv4
| filter timestamp_diff(current_time(), first_seen, "MINUTE") <= 60
| alter user_name = xdm.source.user.username, source_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| fields user_name, source_ip, assumes, first_seen, last_seen
description: Privileged AWS role (Administrator/PowerUser/OrganizationAccountAccess/BreakGlass) assumed from a source IP that identity has not used in the previous 7 days: token replay or cross-account pivot.
alert_name: AWS — Cross-Source AssumeRole or Cross-Account Token Issuance
alert_description:
What fired: AWS AssumeRole, AssumeRoleWithSAML, or AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity SUCCESS with ≥2 distinct source IPs for same role ARN within one hour — possible token replay or cross-account pivot.

Why it matters: an actor is pivoting from one host to others inside the network. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1550.001 - Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token (TA0008 - Lateral Movement).

Investigate:
  - Map the source host, the internal targets reached, and the account used.
  - Check for preceding credential access on the source and for new logons/sessions on the targets.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.user.username) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0008 - Lateral Movement: T1550.001 - Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token
